title: MaterialSummary
description: A BASIC description of an object's first material — enough for the agent to answer 'what colour is it?' and to plan a colour change, and nothing more. Spec 002 is deliberately limited to base colour: full shader/node-graph authoring is out of scope, so no node tree, no image reference, and no file reference is representable here. `base_color` is absent when the material's colour cannot be summarised (a procedural or node-driven material), which is different from 'the colour is black' and must not be conflated with it. NOTE WHAT IS ABSENT: no texture path, no image filename, no library or .blend reference, no node data.

name.description: Blender material name, e.g. 'Material'. A display label, not an identifier the platform resolves against.

base_color.description: Canonical linear sRGB base colour, when the material exposes a summarisable one.
